frontmatter.title: Architecture — Employee Skill Catalog and Skill Profile Management
frontmatter.author: AL Architect

sections.Context: Business context, technical context (BC v22 / runtime 15.2), and scope boundaries (in scope: 6 AL objects across 3 tables, 2 enums, 5 pages, 1 codeunit, 1 page extension, 2 permission sets; out of scope: US-002 goals, correction mechanism, telemetry).
sections.ArchitecturalDrivers: 6 drivers: D-1 immutability, D-2 on-demand effective-dated calculation, D-3 confirmation workflow, D-4 deletion guard, D-5 ConfirmAssessment bypass, D-6 extension-only BC compliance.
sections.ArchitecturalStyleAndKeyDecisions: Master-data / append-only ledger pattern. 5 ADRs: ADR-1 append-only ledger, ADR-2 on-demand proficiency calculation, ADR-3 ModifyAll bypass, ADR-4 inline editable ListPart, ADR-5 permission-set role distinction.
sections.LogicalComponentView: ASCII component diagram: Employee Card extended by PageExtension 51100; Pages 51103/51104 surface skills; Codeunit 51100 holds all logic; Tables 51100-51102 provide storage; Employee (5200) is a standard unchanged FK target.
sections.KeyRuntimeFlows: 5 flows: HR adds assessment (Confirmed), employee self-service adds pending, manager confirms pending (ModifyAll bypass), GetCurrentProficiency lookup, skill deletion guard.
sections.DataArchitecture: erDiagram: SkillCategory 1:N Skill, Skill 1:N EmployeeSkillAssessment, Employee 1:N EmployeeSkillAssessment. Surrogate PK on Table 51102. Secondary key (Employee No., Skill Code, Effective Date) for GetCurrentProficiency.
sections.CrossCuttingConcerns: Security: ESM BASIC/FULL permission sets. Reliability: unconditional trigger errors, user-facing error messages. Performance: SetCurrentKey + SetLoadFields in GetCurrentProficiency. Observability: out of scope v1. Localisation: Caption + ToolTip on all objects. RapidStart: Tables 51100/51101 portable. Upgrade: no migration needed for v1.
sections.CoexistenceWithLegacyHRModule: Employee Card (5200) extended via PageExtension only — one FactBox, one action, no field or trigger changes. Employee (5200) referenced as FK only.
sections.ConstraintsAndKnownLimitations: C-1 ModifyAll bypass documentation obligation. C-2 fixed enum scale. C-3 no correction mechanism. C-4 performance at scale. C-5 ConfirmAssessment missing runtime permission guard. C-6 orphan rows on Employee deletion. C-7 concurrent confirmation race condition.
